description: Eight mono inputs mixed down to a stereo pair, each with its own level, pan and mute

params.text: Sets the level of that channel in the mix, 0 to 100%, and starts at half
Places that channel in the stereo image on an equal-power law, hard left at -50% and hard right at +50%
Takes that channel out of the mix

inputs.text: One of the eight mono inputs; an unpatched jack is skipped entirely

outputs.text: The left side of the mix, clamped to ±10V
The right side of the mix, clamped to ±10V

notes: a centred channel is fed to each output at about 71% of its level, which is what the equal-power pan law gives, rather than at full level to both.
